title: A finite module over a Noetherian ring has a filtration with quotients R/p_i
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and $M$ a finite $R$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. Then there are an integer $n\ge0$, $R$-submodules $0=M_0\subseteq M_1\subseteq\cdots\subseteq M_n=M$ and prime ideals $\mathfrak p_1,\ldots,\mathfrak p_n$ of $R$ such that $M_i/M_{i-1}\cong R/\mathfrak p_i$ as $R$-modules for $i=1,\ldots,n$.
